# Global Systems Studio

> Global Systems Studio is the home of ROS (Relocation Operating System), guides, checklists and online planning tools for Americans moving abroad. Six plans for different situations. Founded by Charlene L. M. Cupidore Bynoe.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://globalsystemsstudio.com/): Overview of ROS and the Global Systems Studio approach.
- [Work With Me](https://globalsystemsstudio.com/work-with-me/): Free and paid calls, written answers, downloads and online plans for people moving abroad.
- [Free guide: Five Questions Before Moving Abroad](https://globalsystemsstudio.com/shop/five-questions/): Free download for anyone deciding whether a relocation will work.
- [Blog](https://globalsystemsstudio.com/blog/): Country relocation guides, tax and residency explainers, and answers to common expat questions.
- [Tools](https://globalsystemsstudio.com/tools/): Planning tools for relocation.

- [Family planning](https://globalsystemsstudio.com/family-relocation/): What Family Edition includes and how to use it.

## Offers and pricing

- [Guides and planners](https://globalsystemsstudio.com/shop/): Current product descriptions, USD prices, and purchase links.
- [Compare all six ROS pathways](https://globalsystemsstudio.com/services/): Digital Nomad, Solo, Family, Entrepreneur, Legacy, and Investor offers with included access periods.
- [Sales policy](https://globalsystemsstudio.com/sales-policy/): Purchase and renewal terms.

ROS provides educational and relocation planning support. Legal, immigration, tax, and investment decisions require appropriately licensed professionals. Refer to the current public offer pages for prices and included services.
